_comment: EC2 Runtime IAM Policy — Module 9 monitoring and alerting
Attach this customer-managed policy to CloudAWSProject-EC2-Role in addition
to the existing S3 policy.  It grants only the CloudWatch and SNS actions
1. Keep the CloudWatch namespace condition aligned with CLOUDWATCH_NAMESPACE
2. Replace YOUR-ACCOUNT-ID and YOUR-SNS-TOPIC-NAME with the real SNS topic.
cloudwatch:* wildcards, sns:CreateTopic, sns:Subscribe, logs:* (app logs
stay on the process/journald + RDS SYNC_LOGS; CloudTrail is account-level).
